message: Predict the ADMET properties (hERG, solubility, BBB) for these SMILES directly, without downloading anything: CCO, c1ccccc1, CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O. Use the ADMET tool with inline SMILES.
Get the molecular properties of the compound named 'flibberdygibbet-42'. If it does not exist, tell me clearly rather than inventing data.
Fetch and clean PDB 1CRN, then select all atoms within 5 Angstroms of residue TYR44 and tell me how many atoms and which residues are in that shell.

Fetch and clean PDB 1STP (streptavidin-biotin). Then compute an interaction probe grid around the biotin binding pocket and report the strongest hydrophobic and hydrogen-bond-donor hotspots with their coordinates.

Dock ibuprofen into streptavidin (PDB 1STP) in the biotin binding site. Fetch the receptor, get a 3D ligand, define a reasonable docking box around the biotin site, run AutoDock Vina, and report the best binding affinity in kcal/mol.
Using the generative molecule tool, generate 5 novel analogs based on the aspirin scaffold, then run drug-likeness gates on the generated molecules and tell me which pass.
